rules.title: Machine release starts Linda with Odoo PO/SO issuance

A preapproved counterparty is an eligibility condition, never an independent order-send trigger. No extra human review, salesperson Ready utterance, record creation, import, retry or unrelated load can initiate issuance. Supplier cargo READY remains a separate downstream verified fact.

Linda issues only the particular authorized, confirmed order, using native report and Mail; no counterpart PO/SO, PlasticOS transaction or load is required.
